name: DFR Gold inc
summary: DFR Gold Inc. engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral properties in West Africa and Madagascar. It explores for gold and zircon deposits. The company's flagship project is the Cascades project located in Burkina Faso. The company was formerly known as Diamond Fields Resources Inc. and changed its name to DFR Gold Inc. in January 2023. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
